claims.text: Pivot-based methods are one of the baselines used in translation models, alongside traditional transfer learning and multilingual NMT.
Pivoting is identified as the strongest baseline, showing significant advantages over other baselines in translation performance.
The performance of pivot-based methods is enhanced when combined with other techniques like MLM and TLM.
